unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፮ — Meraf 6: Grand Master of ቸ and ነ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ቸ and ነ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የቸ እና የነ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: NEBR
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'NEBR' (Leopard) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ቺኮሌት
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Chocolate' (Chikolet). Find the correct missing last letter: ቺኮሌ[ ? ].
games.tips_en: The full word is ቺኮሌት (pronounced Chi-ko-laet).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 2nd form ➔ 4th form ➔ [ ? ] (6th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ቺኮሌት
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Chocolate (Chikolet)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 3rd form 'ቺ', 1st form 'ኮ', 5th form 'ሌ', and end in 6th form 'ት'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: CHIKOLET
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'CHIKOLET' (Chocolate) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ን
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the native 6th form 'N' sound of the ነ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: እናት
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Mother (Enat)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 6th form 'እ', followed by 4th form 'ና', and end in 6th form 'ት'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: CHAMA
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'CHAMA' (Shoes) with the correct Amharic word.
